Process.sectionTitle: How do we prepare your dessert?
Process.step1Desc: No compromises on taste. We use only original Nutella®, Kinder, Oreo, and fresh fruits cut right before delivery for an intense and unmistakable experience.
Process.step2Desc: Our secret is pure freshness. We prepare the dough every morning and use it strictly on that day, for a tender, hot, and unforgettable dessert.
Process.step3Desc: Our thermal packaging protects the dessert on its way, so you can enjoy it exactly as we took it out of the waffle iron, fresh and steaming.

About.subtitle: Our Story
About.title:
Passion for
Authentic Taste
About.desc1: We set out to bring to Chișinău that taste you'll remember. We prepare every waffle and crepe from scratch, every morning, from a simple desire to offer you an honest, hot, and delicious dessert.
About.section2P1: We don't skimp when it comes to the quality of ingredients. For the pistachio cream, we chose to bring authentic pistachios from Sicily, with no artificial flavors or colors, precisely to preserve that rich, natural taste.
About.section2P2: We also prepare the dough fresh every morning, right in our location. We don't use powdered bags or pre-mixes with water. We do everything according to our own recipe, with eggs, milk, and a lot of patience.
About.quote: "Munchotella was born from a simple craving to eat a really good dessert, with lots of chocolate and quality ingredients. We didn't want to reinvent the wheel, we just wanted to make the best waffle you've ever eaten."

Legal.title: Legal Information | Munchotella
Legal.description: Terms and Conditions, Privacy Policy and Delivery Information Munchotella.
Legal.heroDesc: We are here to bring your favorite dessert right to your door. For everything to go perfectly, here are our simple delivery rules and how we protect your data.
Legal.terms1Desc: Munchotella offers ordering and home delivery services for waffles, drinks, and other food items from its own menu within Chisinau.
Legal.terms2Desc: By completing the order, the customer confirms that the data provided is correct. Product images are for presentation purposes and there may be slight differences from the final delivered product.
Legal.terms3Desc: Prices are expressed in MDL. The delivery fee is calculated automatically and detailed in the Delivery section. For distances greater than 1km, the standard taxi rate applies (30 MDL starting + 6.45 MDL/km).
Legal.terms4Desc: Perishable food products prepared to order can NOT be returned according to the legislation of the Republic of Moldova. Canceling an order is only possible by phone within the first 5 minutes of placing it.
Legal.privacy1Desc: We collect name, phone, email, and delivery address in accordance with Law no. 133/2011 on the protection of personal data.
Legal.privacy2Desc: The data is used strictly for processing the order, communicating delivery status, and improving the user experience on our platform.
Legal.privacy3Desc: The application uses GPS location to calculate the delivery fee and to guide the courier to the exact address. This data is not permanently stored in our database.
Legal.privacy4Desc: You have the right of access, intervention, and opposition to the data. For account and associated data deletion, contact us at
Legal.law133: Law no. 133 on the protection of personal data
Legal.deliveryPolicyDesc: The estimated delivery time is usually between 30 and 60 minutes. This time is approximate, and Munchotella is not responsible for delays caused by heavy traffic, unfavorable weather conditions, or other force majeure situations.
Legal.walkingDeliveryDesc: For locations in the immediate vicinity (under 1km distance from the preparation point). The applied fee is +20 MDL.
Legal.taxiDeliveryDesc: An external taxi service is used. The rate is calculated automatically upon order completion according to the formula: 30 MDL starting + 6.45 MDL / km.

FAQ.title: Everything You'd Ask Over the Counter
FAQ.subtitle: From where our fresh ingredients come from to getting your waffles delivered piping hot across Chisinau — here is the real story behind every bite.
FAQ.ctaTitle: Craving something custom or have a question?
FAQ.ctaDesc: We're in the kitchen every evening making things from scratch. Give us a call or drop by — we love talking desserts.
FAQ.q1: Where can I find genuinely good waffles in Chisinau?
FAQ.a1: Right here at Munchotella, at Str. Nicolae Testemițanu 21/1. We make our batter fresh every single morning from scratch — no industrial premixes, no shortcuts. Whether you order our signature 16-piece warm mini waffle box or a classic Belgian waffle, we top them to order with generous layers of genuine Nutella®, Belgian white chocolate, Sicilian pistachios, Lotus Biscoff crumbles, and freshly sliced fruit. You can pull up a chair in our boutique or have them arrive steaming hot right at your doorstep.
FAQ.q2: What makes your Dubai Crepe so popular, and where can I try it?
FAQ.a2: Our Dubai Crepe is made fresh to order at our boutique on Str. Nicolae Testemițanu 21/1. The secret is that we don't cut corners: we take raw kataifi pastry, slow-toast it in pure butter until it turns golden and deeply crisp, then blend it with 100% pure Sicilian pistachio paste (zero dyes, no fake flavors) and rich Nutella®. Wrapped inside a thin French crepe, it gives you that signature loud crunch balanced with warm molten chocolate.
FAQ.q3: When a late sweet craving hits in Chisinau, what can I order?
FAQ.a3: Whatever kind of sweet mood you're in, we've got you covered: warm American mini waffles, delicate French crepes (like our Dubai Crepe or Kinder Crepe), Sweet Sushi rolls stuffed with fresh bananas and strawberries, skewers of waffle sticks, fluffy pancakes, and thick milkshakes made with real ingredients. Everything is prepared fresh the minute your order comes in.
FAQ.q4: How late can I get warm desserts delivered to my door in Chisinau?
FAQ.a4: We deliver hot desserts until midnight (00:00). We're open Monday through Sunday from 16:00 to 00:00 (we rest on Wednesdays). To keep your desserts in bakery-fresh condition, we pack every order in insulated thermal boxes with steam vents, so your waffles stay crisp on the outside and fluffy inside — usually arriving in 35 to 45 minutes across Chisinau.
FAQ.q5: How does ordering work — can I just pick it up or order online?
FAQ.a5: Whatever is easiest for you! You can order directly on our website www.munchotella.md (with quick card checkout or cash on arrival), or call us directly at 079 006 499 (+373 79 006 499). If you're nearby on Str. Nicolae Testemițanu 21/1, pick Takeaway and your order will be boxed up warm and ready when you walk in.
FAQ.q6: Do you use genuine, original Nutella® in your desserts?
FAQ.a6: Yes, 100%! We strictly use original Nutella® — the authentic, rich hazelnut spread everyone knows and loves. We never use cheap generic substitutes, bulk imitation pastes, or diluted glazes. With every order at Munchotella, you get generous scoops of real Nutella®, 100% pure pistachio cream with no artificial coloring, premium Belgian white chocolate, and fresh fruit prepared to order.
FAQ.q7: Which neighborhoods in Chisinau do you deliver to, and how fast is it?
FAQ.a7: We deliver fresh, piping hot desserts across all major districts of Chisinau: Centru, Botanica, Rîșcani, Buiucani, Ciocana, Poșta Veche, and Telecentru, straight from our boutique kitchen at Str. Nicolae Testemițanu 21/1. Average delivery time is 35 to 45 minutes. Every order travels in custom ventilated thermal boxes to ensure your waffles and crepes arrive crisp, warm, and bakery-fresh.
FAQ.q8: Can I send a warm dessert gift or surprise to someone special in Chisinau?
FAQ.a8: Yes, absolutely! Munchotella is a favorite choice for sweet surprises, birthdays, and late-night gestures. Simply place your order online at www.munchotella.md, pay securely with credit card or instant payments, enter the recipient's delivery address, and our courier will hand-deliver the warm, beautifully packaged treat right to their doorstep.
FAQ.q9: Can I place a pre-order during the day before the kitchen opens at 16:00?
FAQ.a9: Yes! While our ovens turn on at 16:00 (we operate daily from 16:00 to 00:00, closed Wednesdays), you can place a pre-order on our website at any time of day. Choose your favorite treats, select your preferred delivery or pickup time slot, and our team will bake everything fresh to order the moment our kitchen opens.
FAQ.q10: Can I customize my dessert or request nut-free / fruit preferences?
FAQ.a10: Of course! Every dessert at Munchotella is handcrafted individually. You can customize toppings (Nutella®, pure pistachio cream, Belgian white chocolate, Lotus Biscoff, Kinder Bueno) or leave a note with your order to omit specific ingredients like peanuts/hazelnuts for allergies or select your preferred fresh fruits (strawberries, bananas, kiwi).
